description: Management Consulting Team — quality gates for agent lifecycle and session management

hooks.prompt: Before this agent stops, verify it has completed its persistence obligations. Check: (1) Has the agent written or updated its memory file at project-data/agent-memory/[name]/memory.md? (2) Has the agent saved all output to the specified output file? (3) If the agent produced findings, were they written to project-data/findings/? If any of these are missing and the agent was working on a consulting engagement task (not a utility task), return decision 'block' with a message listing what still needs to be written. If all persistence is done or this is not an engagement task, return decision 'approve'.

hooks.command: echo '{"systemMessage": "CONTEXT COMPACTION IMMINENT: Before context is compressed, ensure all agents have written their output files and memory. Any unsaved work in conversation context will be lost. Priority: (1) Save any in-progress deliverables to files, (2) Update tracking files, (3) Write EM memory if needed."}'
